ledger: Skater pop (00:00) -> Board lift and flip (00:01) -> Plausible
Skater catch (00:02) -> Board stops flipping (00:03) -> Plausible
Skater landing initiated (00:08) -> Board dissolves underfoot (00:09) -> Implausible, action dissolves

findings.description: The skater initiates a landing motion to land back on the skateboard, but the skateboard completely dissolves from under his right foot. The landing action fails to complete as a physical interaction with the board, instead dissolving into the skater landing directly on the concrete while maintaining a posture as if the board were still present.
